system.description:
Deal [(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. You may only use this skill on a round you have declared [Standby].

(Self: Hidden): Roll this skill's check twice and take either result.
(Critical): The damage becomes penetrating.

A special skill that takes time to find the opponent's openings and unleashes a single blow. It takes some time to unleash, but if you release it while stealthed, it's a deadly surprise.
